item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. High temperatures today range from forty-one to forty-two degrees with lows tonight between twenty-three and twenty-nine, under mostly cloudy to overcast skies. Expect a chance of light snow early this morning, then cloudy or mostly cloudy conditions through the day, with little or no additional accumulation and precipitation chances generally decreasing by tonight. Overnight, skies remain mostly cloudy with only a slight chance of snow showers and low precipitation expected across the region.
